'''Virtual Set 18 (Re-organized)''' is the Original-era plan known as '''Fifth Anthology'''. It was previewed as the 18th numbered Virtual Set (June 2009) but was '''not''' shipped as a standalone Remaster PDF. Preview material was released inside Reflections IV ([[Virtual Block 6]]; PDF official text 4 September 2009).

This is '''not''' the same status as [[Virtual Set 19: Galaxy At War]] (Polish ''niewydany'' / unreleased). Polish inventory lists Fifth Anthology '''without''' the unreleased mark. Block intros still count a reorganization of the previous 18 virtual sets.

Do not invent a full card list here. See primary narrative on [[2009 Virtual Block Reorganization]] (&sect; Fifth Anthology / planned VS18) and the naming/PDF note on [[Cancelled Virtual Sets]]. Era index: [[Virtual Sets (2002-2009)]]. Modern disambiguation: [[Virtual Set 18]].
